clusters.name: Father's remarriage and stepfather's presence, 1987
clusters.reason: Around the time his father remarried, Jonah's relationship with his stepfather became strained while his relationship with his father remained warm. His anxiety rose when he made the chess squad. His stepmother left temporarily over the question of having a baby, adding instability to the household.

clusters.name: Grandfather's death and loss of footing at conservatory, 1989–1992
clusters.reason: His grandfather died in June 1991 after years of illness. Around the same time Jonah began at the conservatory, leaning heavily on his roommate Rafe. A wrist injury stopped his playing that autumn and led to conflict with Rafe. He dropped out, became withdrawn and symptomatic, lost his functioning, and his anxiety rose. His mother's family also reconciled with his grandfather that year, and the household moved into a rebuilt home during this stretch.

clusters.name: Performing burnout, failed audition, and grandmother's death, 2001–2004
clusters.reason: Around 2001 Jonah's anxiety rose and his functioning fell as he lost steam for performing. His grandmother was found to have bowel cancer around the same time. He had a disastrous audition in early 2002 and grew distant from family and friends. He moved away, entered a brief relationship that ended within the year, and sank into deep depression. He withdrew from his parents entirely, relying instead on friends. He reconnected with his therapist and with his parents around early 2004, began swimming, and his grandmother died in February 2004.

clusters.name: Grandparents' deaths and cutoff from mother during nursing school, 2008
clusters.reason: His grandmother died in January 2008 and his grandfather around the same time. That summer at a family lodge before nursing school, he grew distant from his mother and they had a conflict when she visited against his wishes. He left for nursing school in September and stopped speaking to his mother, a cutoff that lasted roughly a year. His aunt had a stroke that year, adding medical stress to the extended family.

clusters.name: Marriage to Wren and tension around in-laws' closeness, 2017–2019
clusters.reason: Jonah married Wren in March 2017 and his contact with his mother eased slightly. His sister had a baby expected that autumn. Around October 2019, Wren became swamped with family events and he overfunctioned to help her. Wren's family is tightly fused—she talks with her father and brother all day and nothing happens to one that the others don't hear. When the family gathered for Wren's mother's retirement at a lake house, Jonah's sleep fell apart; he felt he didn't belong. His anxiety rose and he withdrew. His sleep troubles are at their worst around Wren's family occasions.
